case_number: 2025 INSC 200; SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (C) No.17157 OF 2022
summary: Petitioner, appearing in-person, sought relief; amicus curiae appointed to assist; settlement proposed to avoid protracted litigation; respondent agreed to pay up to Rs.15 lakhs; petitioner claimed higher sum on merits; Court directed payment of Rs.20 lakhs as full and final settlement; petition disposed of in light of settlement; emphasis on role of advocates in assisting indigent litigants and ensuring access to justice; appreciation expressed to amicus for pro bono services.
final_judgment: Special Leave Petition disposed of; respondent directed to pay Rs.20,00,000/- within three weeks as full and final settlement; petitioner to have no further claims against respondents.
